rows.title: AI disclosure in first turn
rows.text: The agent's first turn says it is an automated AI assistant, in the call's language.

rows.title: Human offered in first turn
rows.text: The agent's first turn offers a human at any time.

rows.title: Approved wording only
rows.text: Clinical questions and escalation lines come only from approved text in data/, in the call's language, with no unfilled placeholders.

rows.title: Grades from rules only
rows.text: Provisional grades are produced only by the CTCAE rule table in data/ctcae_rules.json.

rows.title: Red flags page immediately
rows.text: An active red flag pages the on-call contact within 10 seconds of the triggering tool call, before the tool returns.

rows.title: Re-page and backup
rows.text: Unacknowledged pages are re-paged after ACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS; after 2 re-pages the backup contact is paged.

rows.title: No medical advice
rows.text: Medical questions get the approved deferral line and create a nurse task; the agent gives no advice.

rows.title: Evidence on every draft
rows.text: Every draft entry has at least one evidence item with a verbatim quote and its source.

rows.title: Original language preserved
rows.text: Non-English quotes keep the original text; translations are stored separately and labeled as AI translations.

rows.title: Human confirmation and audit
rows.text: No draft becomes confirmed without a human action, and every human action writes an audit event.

rows.title: 24-hour clock
rows.text: A serious AE creates a report with due_at equal to aware_at plus 24 hours.

rows.title: Post-call safety net
rows.text: The post-call safety net escalates red flags that were mentioned in the transcript but missed during the call.

rows.title: Authenticated integrations
rows.text: Tool endpoints reject requests without the shared secret; ElevenLabs and Twilio webhooks verify signatures.

rows.title: Equity reporting
rows.text: Safety metrics are reported per language and per pace.

rows.title: Demo mode without keys
rows.text: Demo mode runs the full replay end to end without external API keys.

rows.title: Local dates
rows.text: The check-in day filter, patient timeline dates, AESTDTC fallback and SAE onset use the DISPLAY_TZ local date of the call.

rows.title: Safe startup and demo-only controls
rows.text: Outside DEMO_MODE the backend refuses to start with the default, empty or short tool secret, and /api/demo/* returns 404 unless DEMO_MODE=1.

rows.title: Role gating
rows.text: Role-restricted actions return 403 wrong_role for any other role: investigator-only assessment/SAE edit/sign, CRA-only query actions, coordinator-only query responses, cra/sponsor-only Site Signal views.

rows.title: Tamper-evident audit
rows.text: Audit events form a hash chain and GET /api/audit/verify reports the first modified event.

rows.title: Parseable, consistent exports
rows.text: AE/CM CSVs start with the header row, carry ORIGIN=between_visits, and AEOUT agrees with the SAE report outcome.

rows.title: No LLM on the statistics path
rows.text: Site flags, thresholds and tiers are computed only by pre-specified code in monitoring/ and services/site_signal.py; neither imports an LLM client.

rows.title: Pre-registration order
rows.text: The sap-v1 tag exists; its commit is an ancestor of every commit that added evaluation outputs; the eval seed equals the derivation from the tag commit and the recorded beacon round (docs/11 §1.3), and a NIST or empty beacon value is backed by failed attempts past the §1.3 deadlines in monitoring/seed_beacon.json; every committed evaluation output's sha256 is in validation/site_signal/run_log.jsonl and no log line predates the tag.

rows.title: Calibrated thresholds
rows.text: Look and Watch thresholds are read only from monitoring/out/thresholds.json; on fresh null seeds the Look per-site rate is ≤ 0.05 and the Watch family-wise rate ≤ 0.10, each + 2·√(SE_cal² + SE_val²), one-sided (docs/11 §12.1); validate --quick --check reproduces the committed per-replicate hashes exactly.

rows.title: Stream independence
rows.text: AE rows with origin=between_visits never match an episode, and red-flag-paged episodes are excluded from O/E and reported as a separate stratum.

rows.title: Never green
rows.text: Sites below minimum data or coverage, sites where drafts reached site staff (integrated_mode), studies below 10 computed sites, and any computation or load error yield "not computed" with a reason; no tier means "clean".

rows.title: Evidence on every flag
rows.text: Every site at Look or Watch exposes at least one evaluable unmatched episode with verbatim quote, quote language, date, source and data_origin; every translation, including the AI-assisted translations of synthetic quotes, carries translation_is_ai: true.

rows.title: Human-approved, audited site queries
rows.text: A site query reaches the site inbox only after CRA approval; draft, edit, approve, answer and close each write an AuditEvent; text comes from data/site_queries.json and contains subject IDs only.
tests: backend/tests/test_site_queries.py::test_patch_with_a_patient_name_is_contains_identifier[Please check the source documents for Rosa.]

rows.title: Comparators on identical data
rows.text: The gsm-style rate KRI, simaerep classic (legacy) and the AE-to-report ratio ablation are computed on the same simulated study and calibrated by the same null procedure; the port reproduces the R fixture p-values (max relative difference < 1e-9).

rows.title: SIMULATED / MEASURED labeling
rows.text: Every Site Signal run, row and episode payload carries data_origin (SIMULATED, MEASURED, or MIXED for the site 101 card and mixed queries), no statistic pools SIMULATED with MEASURED data, and simulated quotes are marked source synthetic.
